text: $\sin x°=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{3},~\cos x°=\frac{\sqrt{6}}{3},~$ $\tan x°=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}$$\overline{BD}^{2}=\overline{AB}^{2}+\overline{AD}^{2}=3^{2}+3^{2}=18$$\overline{BD}=3\sqrt{2}$$\overline{BH}^{2}=\overline{BD}^{2}+\overline{DH}^{2}=3\sqrt{2}^{2}+3^{2}=27$$\overline{BH}=3\sqrt{3}$$\angle \mathrm{DHN}=90-x°$$\angle DBH=x°$$\therefore \sin x°=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{3},~\cos x°=\frac{\sqrt{6}}{3},~\tan x°=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}$

$\mathrm{4}\sqrt{3}cm^{2}$$\overline{OB}=8cm$, $\overline{OA}=4cm$이므로,$\overline{AB}=4\sqrt{3}cm,~\angle AOB=60°$($\mathrm{\because }\frac{\overline{AB}}{\overline{OB}}=\sin 60°$)$\angle OBA=30°$가 되고, $\overline{OD}=\overline{DB}=4cm$이므로$\triangle ABD$의 높이는 $\mathrm{2}cm$가 된다.$\mathrm{\therefore }\triangle ABD=\frac{1}{2}\times 4\sqrt{3}\times 2=4\sqrt{3}cm^{2}$
